_comment: Records for docs/zenodo/upload-to-zenodo.py. Each record lists its files by name; the script looks for them in the folder given with --folder. Edit the metadata here, not in the script.

metadata.title: Interactive oral assessment (IOA) planning and delivery timeline
metadata.description: A week-by-week timeline for running an interactive oral assessment (IOA) in a large unit, from two to three months before semester to the exam period. Each row lists what staff and students do that week, including approvals, scenario and rubric design, tutor training, practice, scheduling, the assessment weeks and moderation. The example comes from a second-year microbiology and immunology unit, with 2025 dates to replace with your own.

metadata.title: Mock interactive oral assessment (IOA): tutorial runsheet
metadata.description: A 60 to 75 minute tutorial plan in which students practise an interactive oral assessment (IOA) in groups of two or three, taking turns as student, assessor and observer. It includes a warm-up, a central briefing on the format and rubric, timed practice rounds, guidance for assessors, observers and facilitators, and a whole-class debrief.
